_comment: The installer's table of layers. lib: paths under lib/ copied to .claude/kit/lib/. files: kit path -> repo path, created if absent, never overwritten once the repo has changed them. claudeMd: section added to the CLAUDE.md block. To add a CI stack: put its workflow in addons/ci/<stack>/ci.yml, add a 'ci-<stack>' entry here like ci-node, and (optionally) a detect rule.

core.description: Guardrail hooks (no sweep-staging, no merge+delete), review skills with their weekly update check, pre-commit secret scan, kit update reminder.

jobs.description: Job isolation: one git worktree per agent job; the main checkout stays on main and clean (hook + pre-commit check + session-start STOP notice).

phoenix.description: Phoenix Studio: pre-deploy check script and a hook that blocks the Studio deploy call until it has passed for the current commit.

ci-node.description: GitHub Actions CI for Node/TypeScript: typecheck, lint, test (when package.json defines them) and a secret scan on every PR.
